hassio_confirm.title: MeshBeacon
hassio_confirm.description:
Add MeshBeacon to show your Reticulum node's status, peers, traffic and resource use in Home Assistant. This is read-only: Home Assistant cannot control the node through it.

Discovered from the app **{app}** (`{slug}`). Only add it if you installed that app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the MeshBeacon app. Check that it is running, then try again.

abort.discovery_only: MeshBeacon is added automatically. In the MeshBeacon app's Configuration tab, switch on "Show MeshBeacon's status in Home Assistant" and restart the app.
abort.invalid_discovery: The details sent by the app could not be used, so nothing was set up. If this was the MeshBeacon app, restart it; if this repeats, please report it.

isolated.title: MeshBeacon is not connected to anyone
isolated.description: Your MeshBeacon node is running, but no peers are configured, so it is not part of any Reticulum network. In the MeshBeacon app's Configuration tab, choose a public network or add a peer, then restart the app.

peers_unreachable.title: MeshBeacon cannot reach its peers
peers_unreachable.description: For at least 10 minutes, MeshBeacon has not been able to reach any of its configured peers. Check your internet connection and the peer details in the app's Configuration tab. MeshBeacon keeps trying automatically.

needs_attention.title: MeshBeacon needs your attention

app_outdated.title: Update the MeshBeacon app
app_outdated.description: The MeshBeacon integration ({integration_version}) is newer than the MeshBeacon app ({app_version}) and may not work fully with it. Update the app: Settings → Apps → MeshBeacon → Update. Your node's identity and settings are kept.

integration_outdated.title: Update the MeshBeacon integration
integration_outdated.description: The MeshBeacon app ({app_version}) is newer than the MeshBeacon integration ({integration_version}), so some of its information may not be shown. Update the integration under Settings → Updates (it comes from the Marketplace), then restart Home Assistant when asked.
